node.statement: Let e_j be an arbitrary projection-basis element of C^m in the sense of def-projection-basis and put P_j=w(e_j). Applying lem-maincb-corner-nontriviality to the same fixed W,A,epsilon,w,e_j (whose hypotheses are precisely those of node 1) gives that S_{P_j} contains a nonzero element and therefore dim S_{P_j} >= 1.
